correctness.rationale: The connected Laplacian resolvent has the uniform projector plus inverse-mobility pseudoinverse expansion, with operator-norm error O(f^-2). The simple nonzero rank-one Perron root admits derivative b^T L^+ b / sum(b). The recruitment scaling follows algebraically; the conductance derivative is a precise mean-zero inverse operator identity. Exact rational Sylvester minors check finite f=10 signs in both graphs and energies 2 versus 2/3. The source-local birth assumption and near-critical scaling are explicit; no finite experiment substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: The infinite-mobility first-order viability threshold loses all network information. Exactly at biologically relevant O(f^-1) recruitment margins, the new L^+ coefficient restores network geometry, determines invasion or local extinction, and differentiates corridor changes at fixed local recruitment rates. Three patches already exhibit an exact strict inversion of the qualitative viability verdict, a motivated boundary absent from leading-order ecology.
